NJ Governor Demands Lieutenant Governor's Resignation

New Jersey Governor Mikie Sherrill has called for the resignation of her lieutenant governor following an ethics report. The report found that the lieutenant governor engaged in improper behavior with women. Fox News reported the call for resignation came after a sexual harassment investigation.
